fields.name: config_byte_a
fields.description: Persistent header/config byte, defaults to 1. Set by FUN_0800850c (byte at save-buffer+0x04 = 1), covered by the xor32 checksum, written to EEPROM word 0 by FUN_080082ec. Exact gameplay role is not visible in the decompiled slice.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800850c writes 1 to save-buffer+0x04; FUN_080082ec stores the buffer via FUN_0803d18c EEPROM words 0..36; baseline.sav logical byte 0x04 = 0x01.
